_note: Zones are a property of (path, agent), not of a path alone.
A zone with green_for and no oracle is a config error and will not load:
a plate without an acceptance test is not a plate. Zones whose domain
oracle is not built yet carry green_for: [] and a pending_oracle note,
which makes them AMBER for everyone until the check exists. That is the
fail-safe direction and it is deliberate.

red.reason: control-plane logic; the mechanical layer is never edited by the stochastic one
schema and migrations cross service boundaries and are not cleanly reversible
infrastructure and job/env deploy configs; changes here only take effect through a rebuild and a deploy, so they wait for the operator
this is the instrument that grades the work; no agent edits the exam it sits

the instructions of the agents that review other agents, and the operator's scale direction; an agent that can rewrite the reviewer above it is not supervised, so these reach the operator even when a master writes them

zones.serves: OPTIMISE — what the system measures, and therefore when it thinks
zones.note: A retro agent tunes what the system sees. The selftest holds the contract: it must still emit a valid reading, still be registered, and its history must still parse.

zones.serves: OPTIMISE — how readings are captured; former categorical red for masters
zones.note: PIT agents still score 100 for leaving their plate onto these files. Masters and retros may land a fix here; touching them still adds a caution score.

zones.serves: OPTIMISE — when agents wake up, and how much reasoning runs per cycle
zones.note: A master that adds an investigating agent wires up what wakes it in the same change; an agent nothing triggers never runs.

zones.serves: OPTIMISE — who investigates this subsystem, and what they are asked
zones.note: The sharpest surface in the system. A master retunes the agents that investigate this subsystem and may add one; it never edits the file that defines itself (deny_self), and the supervisor definitions are RED above.
Inference only. engine.py, persist.py, store.py and db_mapping.py are wiring and stay core. Opens to diarization-qa and pipeline-retro once the fixture replay records a baseline.

zones.serves: SCALE — source breadth; resolver and acquisition paths
zones.note: Profiles plus the resolver layer acquisition-qa actually edits. registry.py and lifecycle.py stay core. Self-improvement may touch the same surface for recurring acquire failures only.

zones.serves: SUSTAIN — narrow helpers for recurring automation defects
zones.note: Strict plate: two files, no new files. Schema, yaml, secrets stay RED.
Proposals, ledger notes, and metric snapshots are normal session output — not control-plane.
